d:
Bharat men sarkari skulon ki sankhya men giravat darj ki ja rahi hai. niti aayog ki ek riport ke mutabik, pichhle 10 sal men sarkari skulon ki sankhya men karib 94,000 ki kami aaee hai.
Halanki, aayog ne yah bhi kaha hai ki skulon ki sankhya men yah giravat rajyon ki kansolideshan yani skulon ko ek jagah sametne ki nitiyon ko dikhati hai. skul peyring aur marjar ab vivadit mudde ban chuke hain. uttar pradesh men sarkar ki peyring niti ko lekar kaphi vivad huaa, vahin madhy pradesh men sandipni vidyalyon men skulon ko marj karne ke phaisle ke khilaph ujjain men bachchon ne aandolan kiya.
